id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ddc: "...Geez, you're cruel, bro! You got my hopes up! I'm waiting for that Queen's whip+1 or better!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1df4: "Wow! What a fine whip! With this I can settle things properly, and Ms. Michiyo will be thrilled!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1dff: "Maybe instead of punishment I'll get a reward! Heh heh, my expectations are rising!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e26: "Maybe instead of punishment I'll get a reward! Heh heh, my expectations are rising!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e09: "Thanks, traveler bro. You're my benefactor. Please accept my gratitude!

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1e97: "I'm Bridget. I have a deep worry I can't tell any of my friends...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eb6: "I'm Bridget. I have a deep worry I can't tell any of my friends...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ea2: "But I can't possibly tell this worry to a traveler. Please leave me alone for now...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ec1: "Traveler, can you keep a secret? If you don't mind, would you listen to my worry?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ed3: "...I see, you're busy, traveler. If you ever have time, please listen to my worry.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1eef: "...Thank you, traveler. Do you know the Medal Academy newspaper? A wall newspaper hugely popular with students.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1efd: "I wrote to that paper's super popular corner, Ms. Rouge's love advice corner, about a love I couldn't tell anyone.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f0e: "...But now I'm afraid to know the answer, so I haven't been able to read the paper.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f1a: "I'd ask someone to check for me, but I don't want my friends to learn I was the one who asked about love.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f27: "...So I have a favor to ask, traveler. Please read the paper for me and see Ms. Rouge's answer.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f38: "The Medal Academy paper should be on the bulletin board in the second-floor corridor.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f44: "If you can't find the board, ask Maple the Hammerhood. She can tell you where it is.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f77: "If you can't find the board, ask Maple the Hammerhood. She can tell you where it is.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f5b: "Well then, traveler, please. Read the paper for me and tell me Ms. Rouge's answer.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f6c: "The Medal Academy paper should be posted in the second-floor corridor of the school building.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f8d: "...Oh my! How awful! The Medal Academy paper got blown to Roc's Ravine!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1f98: "But my troubled heart won't settle over something like this!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fa0: "Traveler, please! Go to Roc's Ravine, read the paper, and see Ms. Rouge's answer for me!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fbe: "Traveler, you read the paper. ...So what did Ms. Rouge answer to my letter?

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fd7: "...To win love, share a secret no one else knows with the one you like. Hehe... just as I thought.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1fe4: "...Traveler, if you read the paper, you already understand, right? My feelings.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ff2: "...Oh, you tease! You know how I feel and you're still keeping me in suspense!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1ffb: "The mood is ruined somehow. Let's start over. Now, traveler, one more time from the beginning.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2015: "...When I returned home to Heliodor, you dashed across the fields and smiled at me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2022: "From that day, that moment, I've been captivated by you. I'm ready to be your bride anytime.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|202e: "...Still, you're in the middle of your adventure. We needn't marry right away. Let's deepen our love slowly.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|203c: "Well then, traveler. This is my love gift to you. Do your best on your adventure.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|204d: "A student and an adventurer won't meet often, but I won't cheat, so don't worry.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|205b: "I'm already captivated by you. I'm always thinking of you.

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2082: "Gathered in this school... are girls... aiming to be lovely ladies... People call this school Medal Girls' Academy...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|209f: "Gathered in this school... are girls... aiming to be lovely ladies... People call this school Medal Girls' Academy...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2096: "Good evening, traveler... ...This is... Royal Medal Academy.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20c8: "Listen, a rule for those living at this academy: never enter Roc's Ravine east of the school carelessly.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20da: "The valley's masters are violent paradise birds. They love shiny things and carry them back to their nests.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2127: "The valley's masters are violent paradise birds. They love shiny things and carry them back to their nests.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2181: "The valley's masters are violent paradise birds. They love shiny things and carry them back to their nests.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20ec: "Your sparkling eyes shine like jewels, so if you approach that valley I can't guarantee your life.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2139: "Your sparkling eyes shine like jewels, so if you approach that valley I can't guarantee your life.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|20fb: "Details are in the book Roc's Gems in the school library. Read it at least three times and deepen your understanding.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2149: "Details are in the book Roc's Gems in the school library. Read it at least three times and deepen your understanding.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2117: "I'll say it as many times as needed. Never enter Roc's Ravine east of the school carelessly.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2164: "Children's curiosity is wonderful, but too much is dangerous. Sneaking out of the dorm at night is out of the question!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2174: "After all, east of this school lies the paradise birds' nest, called Roc's Ravine.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2193: "If you want to know how dangerous they are, read the book Roc's Gems in the school library.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21ab: "This world is very beautiful and full of wonderful, fun things. But that is the world's front face.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21b9: "Where there's light, shadow is born. Behind the beautiful world are many frightening and sad things.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21c7: "A future lovely lady must understand and learn that the world has many sides.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21d8: "As a teacher at this school, protecting students' safety is my duty! I won't allow unauthorized outings at night!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|21f2: "Since the day Yggdrasil fell, the world has been in great turmoil. ...So I have a favor to ask, traveler.

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2595: "I'm Grace, the vice-principal. The other day, while sorting library books, I found a diary in an old book.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25a9: "It's probably a diary left by a graduate, but a mysterious message on the last page keeps nagging at me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25ba: "...Traveler, if you don't mind, could you do some research on the mysterious message in the diary?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25d1: "...Oh, I see. Sorry to keep you when you're busy.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25eb: "Thank you very much, traveler. To begin, the end of the diary says this...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25f7: "From the memory tree's south side, twenty east and five south. I'll bury our youth there. Take it, my dear friend."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2656: "From the memory tree's south side, twenty east and five south. I'll bury our youth there. Take it, my dear friend."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|268b: "From the memory tree's south side, twenty east and five south. I'll bury our youth there. Take it, my dear friend."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|260a: "If that spot is hard to find, change how it looks in the eyes of the gods, and you'll surely get there..."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2669: "If that spot is hard to find, change how it looks in the eyes of the gods, and you'll surely get there..."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|269e: "If that spot is hard to find, change how it looks in the eyes of the gods, and you'll surely get there..."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2615: "If that spot is hard to find, remember the words of this diary, and you'll surely get there..."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2674: "If that spot is hard to find, remember the words of this diary, and you'll surely get there..."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26a9: "If that spot is hard to find, remember the words of this diary, and you'll surely get there..."
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2622: "It may be coincidence, but it feels like a message meant for me, and I can't focus on work...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|262f: "After all, I too have a memory from my youth, talking with a close friend under the big tree just outside that door.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2642: "Please go to the schoolyard in my place and look into the meaning of the diary's message. Once more, here is the message.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26b6: "...It may be coincidence, but it feels meant for me, and I can't treat it as someone else's no matter how often I read it.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26c4: "Well then, traveler, please. Go to the schoolyard and look into the diary's message.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26d9: "Traveler, you looked into the diary's message, didn't you? Did you find anything?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26e4:
Give the memento
to Ms. Grace?
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26f0: "...You still don't know. Take as long as you like, please.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26f9: "Please go to the schoolyard and look into the diary's message.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2727: "...This box was buried there? What could be inside? Well then, let me open it.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2732: Inside the box Ms. Grace opened were a red ribbon and a letter. She took out the letter and began to read...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2742: After graduating from this academy, I will go to a far country. I am to marry the Prince of Heliodor and live as his consort.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2752: As a consort I can't live as I have. Living for the kingdom and its people scares me, as if I'd stop being myself.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2761: The days I spent with you at this academy will be wonderful memories. I will never forget them.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|276d: So please, Grace. Remember me as an ordinary girl, and stay my friend from now on.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2779: As proof of our friendship I give you my red ribbon. It will surely suit you.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2785: "...Oh, how wonderful. This is a letter addressed to me. It's surely from my dear friend.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2793: "She was the most beautiful girl in the school, and the red ribbon in her long black hair suited her so well.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27a2: "On graduation day I first learned she was getting married. We had a huge fight.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27b0: "After that we grew distant. I heard through rumors that after bearing a princess she caught an epidemic and died...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27c3: "I regretted again and again that I hadn't just said congratulations instead of fighting.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27d0: "The days of youth are long gone, but I never once forgot her.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27de: "Thank you so much, traveler. As thanks, please keep the red ribbon.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27ec: "This ribbon is the shape of her youth. It means nothing in the hands of an old woman like me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27fa: "Give it to your friend. Preferably a pretty girl with long black hair.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|281c: "Give it to your friend. Preferably a pretty girl with long black hair.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|280e: "That ribbon is the shape of her youth. It means nothing in the hands of an old woman like me.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|284a: "School is full of young people's vitality. At times that strong force remains in a place of memories even after life ends...

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|285c: "Like this classroom, you see. Though it's none of your concern, traveler. Please don't mind it. Now then...

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2915: "...Traveler, trying to scare me is useless. I sense no spirit in this classroom.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2923: "I'm an excellent sister entrusted with this school. If I sense a mischievous spirit I'll purify it at once.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|293d: "Since Yggdrasil fell, the dead's regrets have piled up and the air is thick with stagnation.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|294c: "This classroom is no exception, you see. Though it's none of your concern, traveler. Please don't mind it. Now then...
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29bf: "Making school lunch is a test of strength! If you think teenage girls are delicate wildflowers, that's your delusion!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29d0: "Those girls' stomachs are bigger than a Gigantes! Not a crumb of bread is left of the lunch I serve!

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a0e: "Tuck it in a fluffy white Champs Sauvages wheat bun for a super luxury hot dog! Angri-La plateau lettuce adds color!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a1c: "The soup is Mama's white stew! Dessert is the finest cake direct from Gondolia and fresh tropical fruit from Lonalulu!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a2b: "All full of nutrition and a hundred points of love! Eat your fill and become lovely ladies!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b48: "All full of nutrition and a hundred points of love! Eat your fill and become lovely ladies!
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a3c: "Oh my, so you want to help? Sorry, I have enough hands now. I'll take the thought!

id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a5b: "Even so, I want the growing students to eat their fill of delicious lunch.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a80: "Heliodor's chipped-tooth bread is a bit hard but very nutritious. Dunk it in vegetable soup and it's tasty.
id./param/region/r017.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a8c: "The delicious bacon is from Gondolia. I can't say what meat it is, but I guarantee taste and nutrition.

tm.「旅人のアニさん 戻ったんだね！\n 女王のムチ＋１以上を\n 用意してくれたの: "Traveler bro, you're back! Did you get a Queen's whip+1 or better?
tm.「……まったく イケずな アニさんだよ！\n 期待しちまったじゃないか！\n 女: "...Geez, you're cruel, bro! You got my hopes up! I'm waiting for that Queen's whip+1 or better!
tm.「わあ！ なんて 立派なムチなんだい！\n これなら きっちりケジメをつけられる: "Wow! What a fine whip! With this I can settle things properly, and Ms. Michiyo will be thrilled!
tm.「もしかしたら お仕置きじゃなくって\n ごほうびをもらえるかも しれないねえ！: "Maybe instead of punishment I'll get a reward! Heh heh, my expectations are rising!
tm.「旅人のアニさん ありがとうね。\n アンタは アタイの恩人だ。\n 感謝の気持: "Thanks, traveler bro. You're my benefactor. Please accept my gratitude!
tm.「旅人のアニさん ありがとうね！\n これなら きっちりケジメをつけられるし\n: "Thanks, traveler bro! With this I can settle things properly, and Ms. Michiyo will be thrilled!
tm.アタイは\nスケバン失格さ:
I'm a failure
as a delinquent
tm.「ごきげんよう わたくしは コルト。\n あまり 自覚がないのだけれど\n わた: "Good day, I'm Colt. I'm not very aware of it, but I smell quite nice, don't I?
tm.「恥ずかしながら ご学友の皆さまには\n 世界で いちばん いい香りの\n くさ: "Embarrassingly, my classmates call me the rotting corpse with the nicest scent in the world.
tm.「こんばんは わたくしは コルト。\n あまり 自覚がないのだけれど\n わたく: "Good evening, I'm Colt. I'm not very aware of it, but I smell quite nice, don't I?
tm.「わたくしは ブリジット。\n お友達の誰にも 相談できない\n 深い悩みが あ: "I'm Bridget. I have a deep worry I can't tell any of my friends...
tm.「でも わたくしの この悩みは\n 旅の方には とても 言えないわ。\n 今は: "But I can't possibly tell this worry to a traveler. Please leave me alone for now...
tm.「旅の方 あなた おクチはかたくって？\n もし よろしければ\n わたくしの悩: "Traveler, can you keep a secret? If you don't mind, would you listen to my worry?
tm.「……そう 旅の方は お忙しいのね。\n もし おヒマができたなら\n わたくし: "...I see, you're busy, traveler. If you ever have time, please listen to my worry.
tm.「……ありがとうございます 旅の方。\n あなたは メダ女新聞をごぞんじかしら？: "...Thank you, traveler. Do you know the Medal Academy newspaper? A wall newspaper hugely popular with students.
tm.「わたくしは その新聞の超人気コーナー\n ルージュ先生の 恋のお悩み相談室に\: "I wrote to that paper's super popular corner, Ms. Rouge's love advice corner, about a love I couldn't tell anyone.
tm.「……けれど 今になって\n 答えを知るのが こわくなってしまって\n 新聞を読: "...But now I'm afraid to know the answer, so I haven't been able to read the paper.
tm.「代わりの誰かに 見にいってもらおうにも\n 恋の相談をしたのが わたくしだと\: "I'd ask someone to check for me, but I don't want my friends to learn I was the one who asked about love.
tm.「……そこで 旅の方に お願いなのです。\n わたくしの代わりに メダ女新聞を読: "...So I have a favor to ask, traveler. Please read the paper for me and see Ms. Rouge's answer.
tm.「メダ女新聞は 校舎２階の渡り廊下にある\n 掲示板に貼りだされている はずです: "The Medal Academy paper should be on the bulletin board in the second-floor corridor.
tm.「もし 掲示板の場所が わからなくなったら\n おおきづちのメープルに 聞いてく: "If you can't find the board, ask Maple the Hammerhood. She can tell you where it is.
tm.「それでは 旅の方 よろしくお願いしますね。\n わたくしの代わりに メダ女新聞: "Well then, traveler, please. Read the paper for me and tell me Ms. Rouge's answer.
tm.「メダ女新聞は 校舎２階の渡り廊下に\n 貼りだされている はずですわ。: "The Medal Academy paper should be posted in the second-floor corridor of the school building.
tm.「……まあ！ なんてことでしょう！\n メダ女新聞が 怪鳥の幽谷に\n 飛ばされ: "...Oh my! How awful! The Medal Academy paper got blown to Roc's Ravine!
tm.「でも わたくしの悩める恋心は\n こんなことでは おさまりませんの！: "But my troubled heart won't settle over something like this!
tm.「旅の方 どうか お願いいたします！\n 怪鳥の幽谷に行って メダ女新聞を読み\: "Traveler, please! Go to Roc's Ravine, read the paper, and see Ms. Rouge's answer for me!
tm.「旅の方 メダ女新聞を読んでくださったのね。\n ……それで わたくしの相談に\: "Traveler, you read the paper. ...So what did Ms. Rouge answer to my letter?
tm.{var:1}は ブリジットに\nメダ女新聞に 書かれた\nルージュ先生の回答を:
{var:1} told Bridget
Ms. Rouge's answer printed in the
Medal Academy paper.
tm.「……恋をかなえるには 好きな人と\n 誰にも言えない ヒミツを共有する。\n: "...To win love, share a secret no one else knows with the one you like. Hehe... just as I thought.
tm.「……旅の方 新聞を読んだのなら\n もう おわかりですわよね？\n わたくしの: "...Traveler, if you read the paper, you already understand, right? My feelings.
tm.「……もう いじわるな人！\n わたくしの気持ちが わかっているクセに\n そう: "...Oh, you tease! You know how I feel and you're still keeping me in suspense!
tm.「なんだか ムードが壊れてしまいましたわ。\n 一度 仕切りなおしましょう。\n: "The mood is ruined somehow. Let's start over. Now, traveler, one more time from the beginning.
tm.「……故郷デルカダールに 里帰りした時のこと\n さっそうと 野を駆ける あなた: "...When I returned home to Heliodor, you dashed across the fields and smiled at me.
tm.「あの日 あの時 あの瞬間から\n わたくしは あなたのトリコ。\n いつでも: "From that day, that moment, I've been captivated by you. I'm ready to be your bride anytime.
tm.「……とはいえ あなたは まだ冒険の途中。\n 今すぐに 結婚しなくても よいで: "...Still, you're in the middle of your adventure. We needn't marry right away. Let's deepen our love slowly.
tm.「それでは 旅の方。\n これは わたくしからの 愛のプレゼント。\n 冒険 が: "Well then, traveler. This is my love gift to you. Do your best on your adventure.
tm.「学生と冒険者じゃ なかなか\n 会えない日々が 続くと思うけれど\n 浮気なん: "A student and an adventurer won't meet often, but I won't cheat, so don't worry.
tm.「わたくしは すでに あなたのトリコ。\n いつでも あなたのことを思っています: "I'm already captivated by you. I'm always thinking of you.
tm.どんな答え\nなのかしら……:
I wonder what
the answer is...
tm.「この学び舎に……集うのは……。\n ……ステキなレディを目指す……少女たち。\: "Gathered in this school... are girls... aiming to be lovely ladies... People call this school Medal Girls' Academy...
tm.「こんばんは 旅の方……。\n ……ここは……王立メダル女学園。: "Good evening, traveler... ...This is... Royal Medal Academy.
tm.「いいこと？ この学園で暮らす者の心得として\n 学園の東にある 怪鳥の幽谷には: "Listen, a rule for those living at this academy: never enter Roc's Ravine east of the school carelessly.
tm.「あの谷の主は 凶暴な ごくらくちょう。\n 彼らは キラキラ光るものが 大好き: "The valley's masters are violent paradise birds. They love shiny things and carry them back to their nests.
tm.「あなた方の そのキラキラとした ひとみは\n 宝石のように かがやいていますか: "Your sparkling eyes shine like jewels, so if you approach that valley I can't guarantee your life.
tm.「くわしいことは 学校の図書館にある\n 怪鳥の宝玉という本に 書かれています。: "Details are in the book Roc's Gems in the school library. Read it at least three times and deepen your understanding.
tm.「わたくしは 何度でも 言いますよ。\n 学園の東にある 怪鳥の幽谷には\n 無: "I'll say it as many times as needed. Never enter Roc's Ravine east of the school carelessly.
tm.「子供の好奇心とは すばらしいものですが\n 度を過ぎてしまうと とても危険です: "Children's curiosity is wonderful, but too much is dangerous. Sneaking out of the dorm at night is out of the question!
tm.「なんてったって この学校の東には\n 怪鳥の幽谷と呼ばれる\n ごくらくちょう: "After all, east of this school lies the paradise birds' nest, called Roc's Ravine.
tm.「彼らが いかに危険か 知りたければ\n この学校の図書館に 置かれている\n: "If you want to know how dangerous they are, read the book Roc's Gems in the school library.
tm.「この世界は とても 美しく\n ステキなこと 楽しいことで満ちています。\n: "This world is very beautiful and full of wonderful, fun things. But that is the world's front face.
tm.「光あるところには 影が生まれる。\n 美しい世界の裏には おそろしいことや\n: "Where there's light, shadow is born. Behind the beautiful world are many frightening and sad things.
tm.「未来のステキなレディたるもの\n 世界には さまざまな側面があることを\n キ: "A future lovely lady must understand and learn that the world has many sides.
tm.「この学校の 教師である以上\n 生徒の安全を守るのが わたくしの務め！\n 夜: "As a teacher at this school, protecting students' safety is my duty! I won't allow unauthorized outings at night!
tm.「大樹が地に落ちた日から\n 世界は 混乱をきわめているでしょう。\n ……そこ: "Since the day Yggdrasil fell, the world has been in great turmoil. ...So I have a favor to ask, traveler.
tm.「帰る家のない ひとりぽっちの女の子が\n とほうに暮れているのを見たら\n こ: "If you see a homeless, lonely girl lost with nowhere to go, please tell her about this academy.
tm.「この学園は 運よく 難を逃れましたので\n ベッドや食料にも よゆうがあります: "This academy luckily escaped harm, so we have beds and food to spare. We'll welcome those girls as new students.
tm.「子供たちは 未来への希望です。\n メダル女学園の 教師一同\n 責任を持って: "Children are hope for the future. All of Medal Academy's teachers promise to protect and raise them with responsibility.
tm.「旅の方が 紹介してくださった\n ふたりの生徒は メダル女学園が\n たしかに: "The two students you introduced, Medal Academy has certainly taken them in.
tm.「癒えることのない 心のキズと共に\n ふたりは 歩んでいかねばなりませんが\n: "Along with wounds in their hearts that won't heal, they must walk on, but they surely have the strength to face it.
tm.「……私は ふたりを信じています。\n メダル女学園の 教師一同\n 責任を持っ: "...I believe in them. All of Medal Academy's teachers promise to protect and raise them with responsibility.
tm.「子供たちは 未来への希望です。\n この学園に入学すれば 道も開けるでしょう。: "Children are hope for the future. Enroll in this academy and their path will open. Please, traveler, I'm counting on you.
tm.「魔王が倒れたと言えど\n 今だ 世界は混乱をきわめているでしょう。\n ……そ: "Though the Dark One has fallen, the world is still in great turmoil. ...So I have a favor to ask, traveler.
tm.「この学園は 見ての通り 平和そのもの\n ベッドや食料にも よゆうがあります。: "As you see, this academy is perfectly peaceful. We have beds and food to spare. We'll welcome those girls as new students.
tm.「旅の方が 紹介してくださった\n ふたりの生徒は メダル女学園が\n たしかに: "The two students you introduced, Medal Academy has certainly taken them in.
tm.「わたくし 副校長のグレースと申します。\n 先日 図書室の本を整理していたら\: "I'm Grace, the vice-principal. The other day, while sorting library books, I found a diary in an old book.
tm.「おそらく 卒業生が残した日記なのですが\n 最後のページに書かれていた 不思議: "It's probably a diary left by a graduate, but a mysterious message on the last page keeps nagging at me.
tm.「……旅人さん もし よろしければ\n 日記に書かれた 不思議な伝言について\n: "...Traveler, if you don't mind, could you do some research on the mysterious message in the diary?
tm.「……あらそう お忙しいのに\n お引きとめして ごめんなさいね。: "...Oh, I see. Sorry to keep you when you're busy.
tm.「どうも ありがとう 旅人さん。\n さっそくだけど 日記の最後には\n こんな: "Thank you very much, traveler. To begin, the end of the diary says this...
tm.「思い出の木の南側から 東に２０ 南に５。\n そこに 私たちの青春を埋めるわ。: "From the memory tree's south side, twenty east and five south. I'll bury our youth there. Take it, my dear friend."
tm.「もし その場所が わかりにくくても\n 神の目に映る姿を変えれば\n きっと: "If that spot is hard to find, change how it looks in the eyes of the gods, and you'll surely get there..."
tm.「もし その場所が わかりにくくても\n この日記の言葉を 覚えていれば\n き: "If that spot is hard to find, remember the words of this diary, and you'll surely get there..."
tm.「ぐうぜん かもしれないけれど\n まるで わたくしに宛てた 伝言のようで\n: "It may be coincidence, but it feels like a message meant for me, and I can't focus on work...
tm.「なんたって わたくしの青春にも\n そこの扉を出て 目の前にある大きな木の下で: "After all, I too have a memory from my youth, talking with a close friend under the big tree just outside that door.
tm.「あなたには 私の代わりに 校庭に行って\n 日記帳の伝言の意味を 調べてほしい: "Please go to the schoolyard in my place and look into the meaning of the diary's message. Once more, here is the message.
tm.「……ぐうぜん かもしれないけれど\n まるで わたくしに宛てた 伝言のようで\: "...It may be coincidence, but it feels meant for me, and I can't treat it as someone else's no matter how often I read it.
tm.「それでは お願いしますね 旅人さん。\n 校庭に行って 日記帳の伝言について\: "Well then, traveler, please. Go to the schoolyard and look into the diary's message.
tm.「旅人さん 日記帳の伝言について\n 調べてきてくださったのね。\n それで……: "Traveler, you looked into the diary's message, didn't you? Did you find anything?
tm.思い出のプレゼントを\nグレース先生に 渡しますか？:
Give the memento
to Ms. Grace?
tm.「……まだ わからないのですね。\n いつになっても いいですから\n どうか: "...You still don't know. Take as long as you like, please.
tm.「校庭に行って 日記帳の伝言について\n 調べてきてくださいませ。: "Please go to the schoolyard and look into the diary's message.
tm.「……この箱が 埋まっていたの？\n いったい 何が入っているのかしら？\n で: "...This box was buried there? What could be inside? Well then, let me open it.
tm.グレース先生が 開けた箱の中には\n赤いリボンと 一通の手紙が入っている。\n先: Inside the box Ms. Grace opened were a red ribbon and a letter. She took out the letter and began to read...
tm.この学園を卒業したら 私は遠い国に行きます。\nデルカダール王国の 王子さまと結: After graduating from this academy, I will go to a far country. I am to marry the Prince of Heliodor and live as his consort.
tm.妃となれば 今までのようには過ごせません。\n王国のため 人々のため 生きると思: As a consort I can't live as I have. Living for the kingdom and its people scares me, as if I'd stop being myself.
tm.この学園で あなたと過ごした日々は\nすばらしい思い出と なるでしょう。\n私は: The days I spent with you at this academy will be wonderful memories. I will never forget them.
tm.だから お願い グレース。\n普通の少女だった 私を覚えていて\nこれからも 私: So please, Grace. Remember me as an ordinary girl, and stay my friend from now on.
tm.友情の証として 私の赤いリボンを\nあなたに さしあげます。\nきっと よく 似: As proof of our friendship I give you my red ribbon. It will surely suit you.
tm.「……ああ なんということでしょう。\n これは わたくしに宛てた 手紙です。\: "...Oh, how wonderful. This is a letter addressed to me. It's surely from my dear friend.
tm.「あの子は 学園一の美少女で\n 真っ黒な長い髪につけた 赤いリボンが\n とて: "She was the most beautiful girl in the school, and the red ribbon in her long black hair suited her so well.
tm.「卒業式の日に わたくしは はじめて\n あの子が 結婚することを知らされてね。: "On graduation day I first learned she was getting married. We had a huge fight.
tm.「それ以来 すっかり 疎遠になってしまい。\n 風のウワサで 彼女は 姫君を産ん: "After that we grew distant. I heard through rumors that after bearing a princess she caught an epidemic and died...
tm.「あの時 ケンカなんかせず\n ちゃんと おめでとうと言ってあげてたらと\n 何: "I regretted again and again that I hadn't just said congratulations instead of fighting.
tm.「青春の日々は もう 遠い昔だけれど\n あの子のことを 忘れたことなんて\n: "The days of youth are long gone, but I never once forgot her.
tm.「旅人さん 本当に ありがとうございました。\n お礼と言っては なんだけれど\: "Thank you so much, traveler. As thanks, please keep the red ribbon.
